messages:
Rina M: Kickoff 9b4observability beta scope decision. We need a tight MVP for pilots that balances customer value and ops cost. Quick favs and objections?
Owen L: Customers are asking for three immediate things: per-route cost exports, quick error grouping, and a simple way to correlate p99 spikes with model rollouts.
Priya K: Pilots (FinRegCo, MedAI) emphasized billing reconciliation and rollout correlation. Week 6 pilot target.
Ben T: Ops reality: full raw-span retention is the cost driver. Two knobs: sampling policy and retention window. We can do high sampling + short retention or low sampling + longer retention.
Dora G: Marketing: call it "sampled traces, limited retention" in external comms. Keep expectations low for beta.
Rina M: Draft MVP (must-have):
- Template dashboard: p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, token spend trend, top-10 routes
- Per-route daily token CSV export, top-N model breakdown, downloadable for billing reconciliation
- Tracing hook: single header to tag route + model_version (structured), default sample-on-error + adaptive upsample for heavy routes
- Error analytics: grouped by exception signature + model_version, show 3 redacted examples per group (7d retention for raw examples)
Owen L: Implementation detail: prefer one header to avoid parsing fragility: X-RW-META: route=/v1/gen;model=redwood-7b;ver=2026-04-01. Make model_version enumerated in the pipeline.
Priya K: Pilot acceptance checklist (customer-facing):
- Must be able to filter cost by route and model_version
- Must be able to see if a p99 spike aligns with a model rollout in the last 24h
- Click an error group -> view 3 PII-redacted example requests
- Download CSV that matches billing window for reconciliation
Ben T: Rough dev estimates: dashboard templates (1.5 sprints), cost pipeline + CSV export (2 sprints), tracing header + sampler (1 sprint), error grouping infra & UI (2 sprints) -> ~6.5 sprints. We can compress by reusing existing exporter and using template widgets.
Rina M: If we must cut to meet schedule, what is least customer-impactful?
Priya K: Customers prefer CSV and model tagging over pretty dashboards. If we cut anything, drop raw-span clickable drilldown; keep redacted examples + exports to S3.
Ben T: Agree. Clickable raw-span drilldown is expensive (indexing + UI) and can be a GA feature.
Dora G: Marketing will be OK with templates for beta as long as we clearly label limitations in the UI and docs.
legal-bot: legal: For pilots with regulated data, example requests must have all PII redacted. Exports to customer S3 require signed access, retention policy agreement, and explicit consent.
Owen L: Sampling policy proposal: default = sample-on-error + reservoir-based sampling for routes where qps > 50 (reservoir = min(2000, qps*2)). Auto-boost sampling for 30 minutes after a model_version rollout event. Provide per-customer override for pilots.
Rina M: Retention defaults: raw exemplar requests (redacted) = 7 days; aggregated metrics = 30 days. Stretch: 30d raw exemplars exportable to customer's S3 on-demand.
Priya K: Action items:
- Owen: write header spec and sampling defaults (due Fri)
- Ben: retention/export plan + S3 export flow + redaction design (due Mon)
- Rina: draft pilot acceptance checklist + UI disclaimer copy (due Tue)
- Priya: confirm pilot signoffs and legal constraints (due Tue)
infra-bot: deployment: obs-canary scheduled 03:00 UTC tomorrow; will ping #eng-oncall on failure.
Ben T: Note: store model_version as an enumerated tag and cap the number of unique versions per customer to avoid high-cardinality index blowup. We'll also garbage-collect old versions after N releases.
Owen L: Also recommend limiting free-text fields in spans and exposing an allowlist for additional trace tags.
Dora G: I'll draft the short UI blurb: "Beta: sampled traces, limited retention. Use CSV/S3 export for full audits." Follow-up doc link to be added.
Rina M: Decision proposal: ship MVP with CSV export + template dashboard + tracing header + error grouping with 7d examples. Treat clickable raw-span drilldown and long raw-span retention as GA stretch.
Priya K: Customers ok with that as long as exports are reliable and redaction/legal boxes are checked.
Ben T: +1
Owen L: +1
Dora G: +1 :sparkles:
legal-bot: +1 (pending written export agreement for pilots)
Rina M: Locking the scope. I'll write the RFC and acceptance checklist and schedule CTL review. Meeting adjourned.
